purpose: Assistant-led structured-parking completion for Prescott and Phoenix after the earlier Tucson/Scottsdale garage batch.
safety: Inventory seed only. No outreach is staged or sent. These are public/municipal facilities; procurement, insurance, licensing and incumbent-contract requirements apply.

records.category_label: public parking garages and structured parking
commercial_service_hypotheses: oil / grease spot treatment and pressure washing
striping, curb, ADA and directional-marking refresh
records.note: Official City of Prescott page confirms a five-story downtown public garage opened in 2005 with glass elevator and pedestrian access. Municipal procurement and existing service contracts apply.
